contests.title: Independence Community School District — Measure CE: Elementary school bonds

provenance.sourceOrg: Benton County Iowa Auditor and Commissioner of Elections
provenance.quote:
Shall the Board of Directors of the Independence Community School District in the Counties of Buchanan and
Benton, State of Iowa, be authorized to contract indebtedness and issue General Obligation Bonds in the amount not
to exceed $24,990,000 to provide funds to build, furnish, and equip additions to East and West Elementary Schools;
and to remodel, repair, improve, and equip East and West Elementary Schools and to improve the sites, including
related demolition at West Elementary?

measures.questionText:
Shall the Board of Directors of the Independence Community School District in the Counties of Buchanan and
Benton, State of Iowa, be authorized to contract indebtedness and issue General Obligation Bonds in the amount not

and to remodel, repair, improve, and equip East and West Elementary Schools and to improve the sites, including
related demolition at West Elementary?

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Authorizes up to $24.99 million in general-obligation bonds for additions to East and West Elementary Schools, renovations, repairs and equipment at both schools, site improvements and related demolition at West Elementary.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Authorize the elementary school improvement bonds.
